title: Fees are improperly calculated in sDaiStrategy.sol and thus subsequent depositors cannot withdraw their full deposits
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, some users may not get their full deposit back.  **Likelihood:** High, will happen everytime `_withdraw()` is called.  ## Description  The fees in sDaiStrategy.sol are targeted at the yield from depositing Dai to sDai.  ``` > (uint256 fees, uint256 accumulatedTokens) = _computePendingFees(_totalActiveDeposits, maxWithdraw); // Compute pending fees             if (fees > 0) {                 feesPending += fees; // Update pending fees             } ```  If the protocol deposits 1000 Dai for x sDai and gets back 1010 Dai for x sDai in one year, the yield is 10 Da
